title: Kerberoasting (Active Directory)
description: Meridian Freight, a logistics company, runs its Windows domain MERIDIAN.LAB. The database behind its Transport Management System runs under a service account, svc-mssql-tms, that carries an MSSQL Service Principal Name and a weak RC4 key, so any domain user can request its Kerberos service ticket and crack it offline. From the foothold user t.okonkwo, roast svc-mssql-tms, recover its password, and read the flag from a share only that account may open.
question: Kerberoast the svc-mssql-tms service account, crack its Kerberos service ticket offline, and use the recovered password to read the flag from the //dc/manifests share.
